classDiagram
    direction LR

    class UIProjectionGateway {
      <<presentation boundary>>
      +submit(DesktopCommandV1) CommandReceiptV1
      +reduce(DesktopEventV1) ProjectionStateV1
    }
    class CoreDesktopAPI {
      <<trusted command and event owner>>
      +handle(DesktopCommandV1) CommandReceiptV1
      +publish(CoreEventEnvelopeV1) DesktopEventV1
    }
    class ChatRunLifecycle {
      <<trusted aggregate owner>>
      +handle(ChatCommandV1) CommitReceiptV1
    }
    class AuthorityDecisionEngine {
      <<trusted policy owner>>
      +evaluate(InvocationProposalV1) AuthorityDecisionV1
    }
    class InvocationBroker {
      <<trusted dispatch owner>>
      +authorize(InvocationProposalV1) ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1
      +settle(CapabilityOutcomeV1) CommitReceiptV1
    }
    class SecretLeaseBroker {
      <<secret owner>>
      +issue(SecretLeaseRequestV1) SecretLeaseHandleV1
    }
    class CanonicalEventCommitter {
      <<canonical sequence owner>>
      +commit(CommitRequestV1) CommitReceiptV1
      +publish(CoreEventEnvelopeV1)
    }
    class RecoveryCoordinator {
      <<reconciliation owner>>
      +recover(ChatId) RecoveryResultV1
    }
    class ProcessSupervisor {
      <<process generation owner>>
      +control(ProcessGenerationV1)
    }
    class WorkerCoreGateway {
      <<worker process boundary>>
      +propose(WorkerProposalEnvelopeV1)
      +receive(WorkerControlEnvelopeV1)
    }
    class HostInvocationGateway {
      <<capability process boundary>>
      +execute(ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1)
      +return(CapabilityOutcomeV1)
    }
    class LocalHistoryCommitPort {
      <<canonical LocalSqlite encoding>>
      +commit(LocalLedgerCheckpointV1) CommitReceiptV1
    }
    class PortableHistoryCommitPort {
      <<canonical PortableProject encoding>>
      +publish(PortableCheckpointRecordV1) PortableCommitReceiptV1
    }
    class PortableRuntimeJournalPort {
      <<strictly noncanonical local operations>>
      +begin(PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1)
      +finalize(VerifiedPortableCommitV1)
    }
    class RepairOrchestrator {
      <<repair decision owner>>
      +activate(RepairActivationBatonV1)
    }
    class BootstrapProtocolPort {
      <<independently surviving trusted helper>>
      +handoff(RepairActivationBatonV1)
      +result(ActivationId) BootstrapResultV1
    }
    class OSProcessTreePort {
      <<platform enforcement>>
      +launch(ProcessGenerationV1)
      +terminateTree(ProcessGenerationV1)
    }

    class DesktopCommandV1
    class DesktopEventV1
    class FrozenRunSnapshotV1
    class AuthorityManifestV1
    class InvocationProposalV1
    class ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1
    class CapabilityOutcomeV1
    class CoreEventEnvelopeV1
    class WorkerCheckpointV1
    class LocalLedgerCheckpointV1
    class PortableCheckpointRecordV1
    class PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1
    class RepairActivationBatonV1
    class BootstrapResultV1

    UIProjectionGateway --> CoreDesktopAPI : typed commands only
    CoreDesktopAPI --> UIProjectionGateway : ordered projections only
    CoreDesktopAPI --> ChatRunLifecycle : lifecycle intents
    WorkerCoreGateway --> ChatRunLifecycle : proposals only
    ChatRunLifecycle --> WorkerCoreGateway : committed controls only
    WorkerCoreGateway --> InvocationBroker : InvocationProposalV1
    InvocationBroker --> AuthorityDecisionEngine : frozen manifest decision
    InvocationBroker --> SecretLeaseBroker : approved invocation only
    InvocationBroker --> HostInvocationGateway : ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1
    HostInvocationGateway --> InvocationBroker : CapabilityOutcomeV1
    ChatRunLifecycle --> CanonicalEventCommitter : semantic transition
    InvocationBroker --> CanonicalEventCommitter : authorization and settlement
    RecoveryCoordinator --> CanonicalEventCommitter : committed stream and outbox
    CanonicalEventCommitter --> LocalHistoryCommitPort : exactly when LocalSqlite
    CanonicalEventCommitter --> PortableHistoryCommitPort : exactly when PortableProject
    CanonicalEventCommitter --> PortableRuntimeJournalPort : portable operational saga only
    RecoveryCoordinator --> PortableRuntimeJournalPort : same-machine reconciliation
    ProcessSupervisor --> WorkerCoreGateway : generation-fenced process
    ProcessSupervisor --> HostInvocationGateway : generation-fenced process
    RepairOrchestrator --> CanonicalEventCommitter : activation decision and checkpoint
    RepairOrchestrator --> BootstrapProtocolPort : durable baton after user gate
    BootstrapProtocolPort --> OSProcessTreePort : slot launch watchdog and rollback

    CoreDesktopAPI --> DesktopCommandV1 : owns schema
    CoreDesktopAPI --> DesktopEventV1 : owns schema
    ChatRunLifecycle --> FrozenRunSnapshotV1 : pins
    FrozenRunSnapshotV1 *-- AuthorityManifestV1 : contains
    WorkerCoreGateway --> InvocationProposalV1 : emits
    InvocationBroker --> ApprovedInvocationEnvelopeV1 : emits
    HostInvocationGateway --> CapabilityOutcomeV1 : emits
    CanonicalEventCommitter --> CoreEventEnvelopeV1 : emits committed
    WorkerCoreGateway --> WorkerCheckpointV1 : proposes
    LocalHistoryCommitPort --> LocalLedgerCheckpointV1 : encodes
    PortableHistoryCommitPort --> PortableCheckpointRecordV1 : encodes
    PortableRuntimeJournalPort --> PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 : stores noncanonical
    RepairOrchestrator --> RepairActivationBatonV1 : creates after approval
    BootstrapProtocolPort --> BootstrapResultV1 : returns

    note for UIProjectionGateway "No authority, secrets, canonical persistence, worker IPC, or host RPC."
    note for WorkerCoreGateway "No host, store, secret, or external-system channel."
    note for HostInvocationGateway "No worker, canonical store, approval, or authority-decision channel."
    note for CanonicalEventCommitter "A Chat selects one canonical history port. PortableRuntimeJournalPort is never semantic history."

data.title: System boundary contracts and DTO ownership
